title: Primary source and external Raw Gadget reference
summary: The sphere is grounded in the sealed dev9 package/source publication. Raw Gadget UAPI behavior is cross-checked against the Linux Raw Gadget reference implementation; the external reference informs native mechanics but does not replace project package authority.
invariants: Project package/source remains authority for Virtual USB semantics.
Raw Gadget reference source is used to validate ioctl direction/configuration mechanics.
Do not infer stronger FIDO, production-security or platform-portability claims from the reference implementation.

provenance.claim: Package provenance records the development baseline and qualified dependencies.
